messages.content: hey luna, u there?
Yep, here. What's up?
morning. rain again lol
Morning! Yep, the sky's being dramatic.
i think toast counts as dinner
Honestly, with butter? totally counts.
no, cats are easier than dogs
I dunno, cats leave you to guess what they want. That's not easy.
remind me what u said about sleep
Keep a roughly fixed wake-up time. Even after a bad night.
wait, i meant tea not coffee
Ah, tea. Then honey and five quiet minutes.
how do i start cleaning this mess
Pick one tiny zone—desk corner, maybe. Set a ten minute timer.
u spelled that wrong
Yep, you're right. I dropped a letter there.
should i text them back now
If you're calm enough to say what you mean, sure. Otherwise wait a bit.
its 3pm and i havent eaten
Please grab something easy now—banana, sandwich, anything.
did the meeting move to friday?
I don't know from here. Check the calendar invite.
i hate this playlist
Fair. Skip the sad songs and put on something embarrassingly upbeat.
ok i did the first step
Nice. That's enough momentum for step two when you're ready.
is this a dumb question
Probably not. Ask it.
my plant looks sad
Check the soil first. If it's soggy, don't add more water.
i said blue, not black sorry
No worries—blue it is. Navy or bright?
cant focus at all
Put your phone out of reach and do just five minutes. Tiny is fine.
thanks luna
Anytime :)
actually nevermind, fixed it
Oh good! What was the problem?
night. dont let the moon boss u around
I'll try. Sleep well, you.
